project.name: Mac Control focus and display sessions
project.identity: The Mac Control focus and display session boundary.
project.audience: Operators who need a visible, exact-targeted local workspace arrangement with proof of the resulting state.
project.core_loop: Plan a display-bound session, execute under authority, observe the resulting layout, and preserve verification or degradation.
project.north_star: Visible workspace changes are exact-targeted, reversible where possible, and proved at the user-visible boundary.
not_this: Claiming visual success from source or hashes

scope.purpose: Plan and verify exact focus, window, and display-bound sessions without confusing layout intent with successful control.
scope.boundary: Owns focus session planning, execution, layout, verification, and control-center presentation; generic invocation authority and provider diagnostics remain outside this child.
non_goals: Claiming visual success from source or hashes
